channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Indian Squash Tour 4: Anahat Singh, Velavan Senthilkumar clinch titles
item.description: Anahat defeated veteran Joshna Chinappa in her second consecutive final on the PSA Tour.

item.title: Asian Games medalist Seema Punia faces a 16-month ban for doping charges
item.description: The 42-year-old discus thrower is a three-time Asian Games medalist, including a Gold in 2014.

item.title: How the Tennis Premier League is redefining the sport in India
item.description: Long time friends Kunal Thakkur and Mrunal Jain are on a mission to expand the tennis footprint in India.

item.title: I hope more girls take up snooker | By World Champion Anupama Ramachandran
item.description: Indian cueist Anupama Ramachandran shares her journey from a Chennai summer camp to becoming India’s first women’s world snooker champion in Doha 2025.

item.title: Guwahati Masters 2025: Tanvi Sharma storms into final; Ashmita Chaliha exits
item.description: India confirmed a title in men's singles as both Mithun Manjunath and Sanskar Saraswat reached final.

item.title: IOA treasurer Sahdev Yadav named India’s chef de mission for 2026 Asian Games
item.description: Sharath Kamal will serve as deputy chef de mission for the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

item.title: Suruchi Singh wins air pistol gold with junior world record at ISSF World Cup Final
item.description: India opened the ISSF World Cup Final with a gold-silver finish in women’s air pistol through Suruchi Singh and Sainyam.

item.title: IPBL 2025: Hyderabad stun Chennai to set up title clash with Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai Smashers made their way from the Eliminator to the final.

item.title: With 300 players registered for auction, Pro Wrestling League set to return from January 2026
item.description: The 2026 Pro Wrestling League will start on 15 January.

item.title: Abhinandh, Ananya, and Subin: The sibling-coach trio rising through the ranks in Indian table tennis
item.description: The rise of Abhinandh PB, his sister Ananya, and coach Subin Kumar, a trio driving India’s next generation of table tennis talent at the 2025 World Youth Championships.
